subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: For iOS Remote Domain endpoints with a system-trusted hostname, what stable identity should replace the current single-leaf certificate pin?
rationale: Source establishes the blocking loop, but automation cannot decide whether public PKI, an application-level gateway identity, or continued strict leaf pinning is the intended authentication boundary without potentially weakening security.

options.title: Public PKI plus gateway identity
options.body: Use platform hostname and CA validation for rotating public certificates, then bind the paired connection to a stable gateway cryptographic identity when the protocol supports it.

options.title: Explicit public-PKI mode
options.body: Add a clearly selected Remote Domain mode that relies on platform hostname and CA validation while preserving strict pinning for other endpoint types.

options.title: Keep strict leaf pinning
options.body: Retain the current security boundary, document Cloudflare anycast and rotating reverse-proxy certificates as unsupported, and replace the looping prompt with a terminal explanation.

recommendation.title: Public PKI plus gateway identity
recommendation.body: Use platform hostname and CA validation for rotating public certificates, then bind the paired connection to a stable gateway cryptographic identity when the protocol supports it.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline most directly routes the iOS gateway trust-model decision to this person.
